summary: Ledipasvir has the strongest type of warning from the FDA because a past or present hepatitis B virus infection can become active again in patients treated for hepatitis C virus [3]. Healthcare providers are warned to test patients for hepatitis B before starting treatment and to watch for flare-ups during and after care [3]. Additionally, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave this drug medium scores of 62 for liver and 52 for heart concerns [M].
